given_when_then.given: A Delivery Partner initiates an action on a Customer Profile
given_when_then.when: The system evaluates the Delivery Partner's role against the permission required to access that object
given_when_then.then: The system denies access to the Customer Profile and records the failed attempt in the audit log

given_when_then.given: A Store Partner initiates an action on an Order Request
given_when_then.when: The system evaluates the Store Partner's role against the permission required to access that object
given_when_then.then: The system denies access to the Order Request and records the failed attempt in the audit log

given_when_then.given: A Platform Operator initiates an action on a Feedback Record
given_when_then.when: The system evaluates the Platform Operator's role against the permission required to access that object
given_when_then.then: The system grants access to the Feedback Record and records the action

success_criteria: Access is denied to a business object when the actor lacks the specific permission for that action.
Access is granted to a business object when the actor has the specific permission for that action.
All access attempts, both successful and denied, are recorded in the audit log.
